note: BLOCKED: its picture is real footage of a real place (STYLE.md §1: "The picture is real footage of a place"). "Last Train Home" is a fictional animated story: no real footage of it exists. Building this style on our own animated master would mean putting a filter over the original film (the brief forbids it), and fabricating footage that looks real would present a simulation as authentic recording (the brief forbids that too). Not substituted with a generic version.
short: Real footage of a real place; the story is fiction.
